t: Wi-Fi and cellular IoT boards that connect student projects to the internet.
steps: Find the education program on the Particle site.
Ask IT to check the school Wi-Fi. The Photon 2 does not work with a captive portal or enterprise login.
Create a Particle account for each student or team.
Add the devices to a class product. Classes over 100 student accounts cannot use a class product.
Install Particle Workbench with VS Code on the lab computers.
